sentence: This project tries to find out whether genetic variations affect how diabetic foot ulcers heal in type 1 and type 2 diabetics.
This project builds compounds that boost a potassium channel in fast-spiking interneurons to restore balance in autism spectrum disorder and schizophrenia.
This project builds AI models that use computer vision and machine learning to predict disease outcomes and treatment response in cervical and anal cancers.
This project tests whether implanted adult muscle stem cells can restore muscle activity in paralyzed vocal fold muscles without damaging the vocal folds.
This project builds AI tools that automatically detect and measure microscopic features of interstitial lung disease in optical coherence tomography images.
This project develops biomarkers that detect aggressive prostate cancer at a localized stage while avoiding unnecessary testing and overtreatment.
This project studies how psychosocial risks in veterans, such as housing instability, relate to complications of major cancer surgery.
This project provides sequencing, mass spectrometry and microbial storage services to support research on the microbial environment and human health.
This project builds a library of patient CT data and a software platform to train and test AI methods that reduce noise in CT images.
This project studies how autoimmune reactions cause heart and lung toxicities after radiotherapy and immunotherapy.
This project studies how Aedes aegypti mosquitoes taste chemicals and how a long-lasting repellent keeps them away.
This project tests whether the natriuretic peptide clearance receptor changes energy use in the failing heart in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
This project studies the role of internal methylation of mRNA, including during neuronal differentiation.
This project tries to find out which ecological forces make infant microbiomes assemble into distinct states.
This project builds a lasting archive for sharing brain image data from confocal fluorescence microscopy.
This project keeps a central collection of rat strains, embryonic stem cells and related reagents and shares them with biomedical researchers.
This project studies how a cholesterol metabolic enzyme and its metabolite affect brain injury in ischemic stroke.
This project studies how sperm RNA and its modifications pass diet-induced metabolic disorders from father to offspring.
This project develops an MRI method to detect early response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in breast cancer patients.
